claim: PR #20 verifier authenticated comment/reply identity but did not bind claim-bearing finding/reply semantics strongly enough.
basis: Confirmed by development adjudication and the accepted PR #20 remediation that added exact body/update bindings and negative semantic regressions.

claim: Executable prevention references were accepted from checkout filesystem state instead of tracked regular files in the exact Git tree.
basis: Confirmed by development reproduction; remediation moved repository reference authority to git ls-tree HEAD and added .git/untracked/staged/symlink regressions.

claim: The cross-chat repeat-prevention process was normatively duplicated across DEVELOPMENT_PROTOCOL and a second mutable document.
basis: Confirmed against immutable BASE ownership rules; remediation restored DEVELOPMENT_PROTOCOL as sole normative owner and made the second document explanatory only.

claim: BOUNDED_FOLLOW_UP accepted arbitrary non-empty strings rather than recoverable durable locators.
basis: Confirmed by direct validator reproduction; remediation constrained locator syntax/authority and added negative regressions.

claim: UNKNOWN_PENDING_ANALYSIS could coexist with an apparently complete search state and disappear from startup visibility.
basis: Confirmed by direct validator/summary reproduction; remediation made pending analysis bounded and visible, then later strengthened retirement handling.

claim: The explanatory repeat-prevention document still duplicated mutable live registry inventory despite no longer being a normative owner.
basis: Confirmed by direct document review; remediation removed copied live pattern state and added a regression that keeps the explanatory page pointer-only.

claim: A RETIRED top-level status could hide unresolved BOUNDED_FOLLOW_UP or UNKNOWN_PENDING_ANALYSIS state from active retrieval.
basis: Confirmed by direct validator reproduction; remediation prohibited retirement while unresolved debt remains and classified the recurrence as DFP-0006-O002 / GUARD_TOO_NARROW.

claim: PROCESS_INCIDENT authority accepted a generic owner-authored comment marker plus occurrence SHA without binding the source comment update identity/body digest or the claimed failure class and exact occurrence tuple.
basis: Confirmed by direct inspection of the exact-head authority verifier and the current P1 review finding; remediation adds exact non-HEAD process-incident manifest binding, source body/update verification, and claim-specific occurrence mapping.
